description: This file defines the `Returns` class within the Opencart admin mail controller namespace, responsible for handling email notifications related to product returns. The primary method `index` prepares and dispatches email tasks when a return status changes or a return is processed, including localization and dynamic content generation.

classes.name: Returns
classes.description: Controller class for handling email notifications related to product returns within the admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to prepare and send return notification emails. It gathers return and order information, localizes content, and queues email tasks.
